statement: The measured 283-byte Bluetooth HID descriptor of one physical Xbox Series reference matches the example described by xbox-cgap-descriptor-example byte for byte.

applicability.revision: One physical USB 045e:0b12 and Bluetooth 045e:0b13 reference; model label unconfirmed
applicability.firmware: Not verified; Bluetooth evdev identity version 0x0523 is separate from installed firmware
applicability.scope: The descriptor bytes of this reference only. Raw reports, firmware identity, cadence, battery, and independent physical motor actuation remain unmeasured.
